purpose: T34 P14/P15 resource tracking and idle

summary.pendingAtUnload: resize.grow / resize.shrink alternating, with one 200 ms-delayed client

summary.clientConfigureDelaysMs: seeded choice of 0/0/0/120/300 per spawned window

idle.method: utime+stime of the nested kwin_wayland from /proc/<pid>/stat (USER_HZ=100, 10 ms resolution), and per thread /proc/<pid>/task/*/schedstat run time (ns) and voluntary context switches (wakeups); fixtures left mapped and idle; the harness touches KWin only at the window boundaries
idle.caveat: nested KWin on a desktop machine with its own background load (machine state recorded); CPU figures are indicative
idle.zeroMeans: fewer than one clock tick (10 ms) of KWin CPU in the window, i.e. < 10 ms per 60 s

summary.skipped: Plastile commands (toggle-float, swap, ratio, layout.next); the activation before them is kept

supersededChurnUnits.reason: churn units of campaign-320cf72 (commit 320cf72) summed the counters of the threads alive at each snapshot, so the first P15 idle pair reported negative wakeups when a KWin thread ended, and they recorded no RssAnon; rerun at 329f7d3
